name: Singapore Customs · GST on low-value goods
why_not_automatic: manual by decision, CONVENTIONS rule 14: tariff schedules and de minimis thresholds are not legislation, differ in shape in every economy, and answer four indicators — a researcher reads the figure and records it with the page and the date
what_to_look_for: The de minimis, stated as **S$400 CIF, air or post, excluding liquor and tobacco**. **The relief was NOT abolished on 2023-01-01** — what changed is that GST on the same goods is collected at the point of sale under the Overseas Vendor Registration regime. Much secondary commentary gets this wrong. Customs is authoritative for the border relief; IRAS for GST liability and OVR
breadth_basis: measured: the page states the figure
